President, Flooring Rest of the World
Chief Operating Officer; to become Chief Executive Officer
Appointment (to CEO) / Ceases interim segment lead
Will succeed Paul De Cock (who had led the segment on an interim basis)
More than 30 years of international leadership experience at Solvay, including senior executive roles across Europe and the U.S.
Had been leading the Flooring Rest of the World segment on an interim basis in addition to COO duties
